title: Work-package assurance report — v1.0
description: The container a work package's CI run emits at its manifest's own report.emit path (ci/results/WP-*.json), when report.per_obligation_assurance_record is true. chainlink #25: G14 needs an ACHIEVED side to evaluate satisfies() against, and #23 defined the per-obligation record (docs/achieved-assurance-schema.json) without defining where a gate finds one. This is that mapping and nothing more. Machine-emitted, never hand-authored and never human-reviewed -- it carries no review block for exactly the reason an achieved record carries none (docs/achieved-assurance-schema.json: a human freely authoring what was 'achieved' would be indistinguishable from fabricating a verification result). Each `record` is deliberately typed only as an object here: scripts/satisfies.py validates every achieved record against its own schema internally and fails closed on an invalid one, so re-stating that shape here would create a second copy to drift.

work_package.description: The work_package id of the manifest this report is the result of. G14 rejects a report whose id disagrees with the manifest that pointed at it -- a report file swapped for another work package's would otherwise satisfy the wrong obligations.

obligation_records.description: One entry per obligation this work package claims to have established -- its manifest's definition_of_done.provided_guarantees. May be empty: a work package whose run produced nothing is an honest (and, at G14, a blocking) state, not an invalid report.

bridge_records.description: One entry per bridge in definition_of_done.required_preconditions_to_establish -- plan.md §8.2: 'the assurance result records whether the verifier established the implication at each call site'.

record.description: An achieved assurance record (docs/achieved-assurance-schema.json). Validated by scripts/satisfies.py, not here -- see this schema's own description.
An achieved assurance record for the bridge implication itself.
